summary: The chapter earns its central image — Stettler seeing the Vogel and Aebischer folders sit side by side before re-burying them under the others — but two moments still explain what the scene has already shown, and a closing paragraph re-narrates the theme instead of ending on the blind, faceless mirror.

issues.unit: Es war keine Frage. Ihre Stimme war ruhig
issues.fix_hint: Cut 'Es war keine Frage... wie man einen Betrag feststellt oder ein Datum.' Keep only Berta's line and let its flatness stand unglossed.

issues.unit: Der Fall Aebischer war abgeschlossen, wie der Fall Vogel
issues.fix_hint: Delete the final paragraph; the chapter ends on 'Er zog den Schlüssel ab und steckte ihn ein' or on the faceless reflection in the cabinet door.
This repeats Berta's 'Sie drehte sich nicht um' without adding anything the first instance didn't already carry; cut 'und keiner sah dem anderen nach.'
